_note: Emergency THANK YOU page. This is the conversion destination the ad platform's tag fires on, so it must be its own URL. It is still a real page: what happens next, who the patient will see, and the phone number for anyone whose pain will not wait for a call back.
ty.announce-note: · The office will call you back
ty.h1: Thank you. Your request is with the Clifton office.
ty.lead: Someone from Marvel Dental will call you back Tuesday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, or Saturday, 8am to 4pm, to work out how urgent this is and find you the earliest opening. If the pain will not wait, call now instead of waiting for us.
ty.meta: A request is not a confirmed appointment until the office has spoken with you. Urgent visits are scheduled by clinical need and availability.
ty.next-h2: Four steps, and no surprises in any of them.
ty.next-text: So you know exactly what you have started, and what you have not committed to.
ty.step1-text: The team asks what happened, how bad the pain is, and how long it has been going on, then offers the earliest opening the schedule allows.
ty.step2-text: You see Dr. Anna Gazu at 1113 Main Avenue, Suite A, in Clifton. Bring your insurance card and a list of any medication you take.
ty.step3-text: You are told what is causing it, what the options are, and what each one costs, before any treatment begins. An emergency exam is typically $75 to $200.
ty.step4-text: Nothing goes ahead unless you say so. Your benefits are verified during the visit, and financing is available for anything left over.
ty.provider-caption: CLIFTON, NJ · FOUNDER OF MARVEL DENTAL
ty.provider-h2: The dentist you reach is the dentist who treats you.
ty.provider-text: Dr. Anna Gazu founded Marvel Dental and leads every case herself, with 15 years in dentistry, a BusinessRate Top 10 Dentist listing for Clifton in 2026, and sedation options for patients who need them. The practice speaks English, Arabic, Russian and Spanish.
ty.reviews-h2: 4.8 out of 5, across more than 200 reviews.
section-mist12.text: Marvel Dental patients rate the practice 4.8 from over 200 public reviews. The films below are the practice's own patient stories.
ty.legal: Urgent visits are scheduled by clinical need and availability. A request is not a confirmed appointment until the office has spoken with you. Individual results vary.
